title: Theo and the Cipher
author: Rosalind Galloway
blurb: Bram Thackeray, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
